shortDescription: Lockheed Martin earlier this year clinched a Patriot missile contract valued at $59 billion. "Patriot Missile Sprint Is Running Ahead of Plan, CEO Says — WSJ," at 1:32 p.m. ET, incorrectly said the contract was valued at $35 billion.
